[package]
name = "semio-s-fem-mesh"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.95"
description = "Independent binary64 planar meshing and region volume surfaces"

[workspace]
resolver = "2"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "s-module"
id = "fem-mesh"

[lib]
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-job = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🧵️job/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🔨️modules/🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0.149"

[profile.dev]
debug = false
incremental = false
